title: 美股盘前：油价与长债回落推升期指，CEG、AMD与NVDA获正反馈；IDCC重挫
summary: 截至20:36 CST，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别上涨约0.55%、0.39%和0.61%，10年期美债收益率回落至约5.26%，Brent跌近2%至98.35美元。CEG因Google 3590兆瓦电力协议涨6.4%，AMD因2027年AI芯片增供计划涨1.9%，NVDA涨0.9%；OPCH的21%涨幅仅列并购套利观察，IDCC跌12.8%、AGCO跌7.0%。PENG今晚盘后财报给出中等beat概率判断。

entries.title: 港股科技修复获开盘确认，恒指与恒科齐升逾1%；A股长假休市，高利率仍限制追价
entries.title_en: Hong Kong tech rebound confirmed as HSI and HSTECH rise over 1%; Mainland holiday and high yields still cap chasing
entries.summary: A股国庆休市至10月7日，9月30日AKShare基线仍只作参考。港股10月6日恒指开盘涨1.00%、恒科涨1.02%，09:31分别扩大至约1.22%和1.35%，数据中心板块普涨，确认隔夜科技映射已由“待验证”转为本地盘面确认。10年期美债收益率约5.31%与Brent仍在100美元上方继续限制估值扩张；美股双排行快照停留在10月2日现金时段，维持0行降级。四只个股均保留条件式验证，峰岹科技H股09:31尚无成交，未包装为正反馈。

关键词云图

A股休市 纳指新高 长债5.31% 半导体订单 航运长协 恒科确认 排行降级 高油价 增持计划 传感器并购
利好利空中性
重大新闻汇总
海外
美股科技股推动纳指创收盘新高
10月5日标普500涨约0.67%、纳指涨约1.1%、道指涨0.18%；Nvidia、Meta与Microsoft领涨，但指数上涨集中于大型科技，不能外推为全面风险偏好改善。
夜盘
亚洲早盘期指延续温和风险偏好
Bloomberg经SWI于08:13 CST报道纳指100期货约涨0.2%，标普500期货小幅走高；这是本轮可核验的运行时期指证据，道指具体数值未取得。
商品
油价回落但绝对水平仍高
Reuters显示10月5日布伦特结算跌1.89%至100.32美元、WTI跌1.84%至89.43美元；供应缓和利于航运燃料成本与下游，但中东物流瓶颈仍限制风险回落。
市场
A股继续休市，旧快照只作基线
沪深市场国庆休市至10月7日。AKShare于10月5日生成的最近有效A股市场日仍是9月30日：上证+0.31%、沪深300+0.29%、深证-0.11%、创业板-0.23%、科创50-2.51%；2566涨、2824跌、175平，中位数-0.09%。
港股
恒指与恒科高开逾1%，科技修复获确认
10月6日恒指开盘报24279.63点、涨1.00%，恒科开盘报4226.38点、涨1.02%；09:31两者分别约涨1.22%和1.35%。阿里巴巴-W开盘涨2.94%、美团-W涨1.91%、中芯国际涨0.98%，数据中心板块普涨，科技修复由待验证转为本地盘面确认。
政策
52个制造业项目向民资公开推介
国家发改委9月29日公开推介52个制造业项目，预计总投资524亿元、拟引入民间资本155亿元，覆盖化工、非金属、金属制品与通用/专用设备；利好取决于项目落地与订单兑现。
政策
集成电路税收与绿色制造政策继续落地
工信部9月30日启动2026年度享受增值税加计抵减政策的集成电路企业清单制定，9月29日开展绿色工厂推荐和动态管理；政策方向支持半导体与节能改造，但名单资格不等于当期利润。
产业
科技强国部署强化AI、集成电路与工业母机
国新办9月29日发布会提出“十五五”期间体系化布局国家重大科技任务，聚焦人工智能、量子科技、生命科学以及集成电路、工业母机等重点领域；仍需公司级订单和价格反馈筛选。
公司
盛美上海在手订单170.73亿元，同比增88.20%
公司公告显示截至9月29日在手订单170.73亿元。A股9月30日收294.28元、跌3.02%，公告在收盘后披露，长假期间没有公告后的交易价格，不能声称市场已确认。
公司
招商轮船签署25年VLOC长期运输协议
公司全资子公司香港明华签署6艘VLOC船舶25年长期运输协议，总金额预计不低于28亿美元；9月30日收20.15元、涨1.31%，合同在盘后披露，长期履约、资本开支及铁矿石贸易周期仍是风险。
公司
东阳光披露6亿至12亿元增持计划
控股股东及一致行动人计划六个月内合计增持不低于6亿元、不高于12亿元；9月30日收30.37元，增持有价格信号意义，但执行节奏、上限不等于承诺完成额。
公司
峰岹科技拟1.18亿美元收购Sciosense
公司拟通过全资子公司收购Sciosense 100%股权及股东贷款债权，交易总对价约1.18亿美元，仍需股东大会等条件；A股9月30日收199.31元、跌2.46%，港股10月5日可靠收盘价本轮未取得，不能称收购获市场确认。

美股夜盘行情总结

期指
纳指100期货约+0.2%，标普500期货小幅走高
08:13 CST运行时证据确认隔夜大型科技偏强延续；道指具体数值未取得，未补造。
板块对照
排行快照过期，代表股逐行对照不可执行
当前文件仅覆盖10月2日现金时段，未覆盖最近10月5日交易，故行业与概念均0行；不能用ELMT、TGB、PL等旧样本判断确认、背离或潜在反转。
商品
原油下跌与科技期指上行形成温和风险缓冲
WTI 10月5日结算跌1.84%，对下游成本为边际利好；但Brent仍在100美元上方且长债收益率高，未形成全面风险偏好信号。

盘前结论

A股继续休市，港股科技修复已获开盘确认。恒指与恒科高开逾1%，且09:31恒科涨幅扩大至约1.35%，数据中心与大型平台股提供广度确认；但5.31%的长债收益率和Brent仍在100美元上方，限制追价与估值扩张。A股四项公司事件仍缺少公告后成交确认；美股排行快照过期，不以旧榜驱动今日主题。

重点个股关注

盛美上海
A.688082
条件关注
事件：在手订单170.73亿元、同比增88.20%，业务证据直接指向半导体设备需求。
价格反馈：9月30日收294.28元、跌3.02%；公告于盘后披露，长假期间没有公告后A股成交，当前仅能列观察。
确认/失效：10月8日复市后若成交放大且相对半导体设备指数走强，可确认；若高开低走并跌破公告前收盘、或订单取消与交付延后，则失效。
招商轮船
A.601872
条件关注
事件：6艘VLOC、25年长期运输协议总金额预计不低于28亿美元，为干散货船队提供长期合同能见度。
价格反馈：9月30日收20.15元、涨1.31%，但正式公告在盘后，尚无公告后成交确认。
确认/失效：复市后量价强于航运板块且公司进一步披露船舶交付与收益节奏可确认；资本开支上升、履约推迟或铁矿石运输需求转弱构成失效。
东阳光
A.600673
条件关注
事件：控股股东及一致行动人计划六个月内合计增持6亿至12亿元，并有回购倡议，提供资本动作催化。
价格反馈：9月30日收30.37元；公告后没有A股交易，不能把计划金额当作已完成买盘。
确认/失效：以后续实际增持进度、复市成交和相对强度确认；若增持迟缓、交易风险加大或复市显著弱于材料/科技板块，则失效。
峰岹科技
A.688279 / H.01304
条件关注
事件：拟以约1.18亿美元收购Sciosense，补充传感器能力并与电机驱控芯片形成协同。
价格反馈：A股9月30日收199.31元、跌2.46%；H股10月5日收121.20港元，10月6日09:31尚无成交，不能把静态昨收包装成收购获市场确认。
确认/失效：股东大会批准、交易条款兑现且H/A两地后续价格不出现明显负反馈可确认；估值过高、审批失败、整合与商誉压力构成失效。

板块轮动看板

半导体设备政策与盛美订单构成双催化；等待10月8日A股复市后的量价和交付确认。
航运/干散货长协增强远期能见度，油价回落缓和成本；仍看船舶交付、运价和铁矿石需求。
港股科技恒科开盘涨1.02%、09:31扩大至约1.35%，数据中心与大型平台股普涨；本地广度确认改善，但高利率下仍防冲高回落。
长久期成长10年期美债约5.31%，若收益率继续上行，科技修复可能集中于少数龙头。

逻辑链

纳指新高、Nvidia等大型科技领涨 → 港股科技情绪映射 → 恒指与恒科高开逾1%、数据中心板块普涨，映射获本地确认。
美股排行快照未覆盖10月5日 → 无可靠行业/概念横截面 → 今日不从旧Top5推导A/H主题或个股。
盛美订单与集成电路政策 → 半导体设备基本面线索 → A股10月8日复市后验证价格与订单交付。
招商轮船25年长协 + 油价回落 → 航运现金流与成本预期改善 → 船舶交付、运价与合同执行决定兑现。

风险雷达

利率与估值10年期美债约5.31%，科技上涨集中于龙头，港股高估值成长容易出现冲高回落。
长假价格真空A股公司公告均缺少公告后成交反馈，10月8日复市可能出现跳空与获利回吐。
数据时效AKShare A股基线为9月30日、美股排行仅覆盖10月2日；两者均已按旧时段标记，未外推为今日实时。
并购与合同执行收购需审批与整合，长期运输合同需资本开支和多年履约，公告金额不等于当期利润。

数据来源与时间点

Keyword Cloud

Mainland holiday Nasdaq record 10Y at 5.31% Semicap orders Shipping contract HK tech confirmed Rankings degraded High oil Purchase plan Sensor acquisition
PositiveNegativeNeutral
Major News
GLOBAL
Big Tech lifts Nasdaq to a record close
On Oct 5, the S&P 500 gained about 0.67%, the Nasdaq about 1.1% and the Dow 0.18%. Nvidia, Meta and Microsoft led, but concentrated leadership does not imply a broad risk-on move.
FUTURES
Early-Asia futures extend the risk tone modestly
Bloomberg via SWI reported Nasdaq-100 futures up about 0.2% and S&P 500 futures edging higher at 08:13 CST. A reliable Dow futures percentage was unavailable and is not inferred.
COMMODITIES
Oil falls, but absolute prices remain high
Reuters reported Brent settling 1.89% lower at $100.32 and WTI down 1.84% at $89.43 on Oct 5. Lower oil helps transport costs, while Middle East logistics remain a risk.
MARKET
Mainland shares remain closed; old data are baseline only
Mainland markets are closed through Oct 7. The latest valid AKShare A-share session is Sep 30: Shanghai +0.31%, CSI 300 +0.29%, Shenzhen -0.11%, ChiNext -0.23% and STAR 50 -2.51%; 2,566 rose, 2,824 fell and the median was -0.09%.
HONG KONG
HSI and HSTECH open over 1% higher, confirming the tech rebound
On Oct 6, the Hang Seng opened at 24,279.63, up 1.00%, and HSTECH at 4,226.38, up 1.02%; by 09:31 they were up about 1.22% and 1.35%. Alibaba-W opened +2.94%, Meituan-W +1.91% and SMIC +0.98%, while data-center shares rose broadly, turning the local test from pending to confirmed.
POLICY
Fifty-two manufacturing projects opened to private capital
NDRC published 52 projects on Sep 29, with CNY52.4bn of planned investment and CNY15.5bn sought from private capital across chemicals, materials and equipment. Benefits depend on execution and orders.
POLICY
IC tax and green-manufacturing measures advance
MIIT launched work on the 2026 IC VAT super-deduction eligibility list on Sep 30 and green-factory recommendations on Sep 29. Eligibility is supportive but is not current-period profit.
INDUSTRY
Technology-power strategy highlights AI, ICs and machine tools
A Sep 29 State Council Information Office briefing described systematic major science programs for AI, quantum, life science, integrated circuits and industrial machine tools; company orders and price feedback still decide investability.
COMPANY
ACM Research Shanghai orders reach CNY17.073bn, up 88.20%
The company reported orders as of Sep 29. Shares closed at CNY294.28, down 3.02%, on Sep 30; the disclosure came after the close, so there is no post-announcement trading confirmation during the holiday.
COMPANY
China Merchants Energy Shipping signs a 25-year VLOC contract
Its subsidiary signed a 25-year agreement for six VLOC vessels worth at least $2.8bn. Shares closed at CNY20.15, up 1.31%, before the after-close disclosure; delivery, capex and iron-ore cycles remain risks.
COMPANY
HEC discloses a CNY0.6-1.2bn shareholder purchase plan
The controlling shareholder and concert parties plan purchases over six months. The stock closed at CNY30.37 on Sep 30; a planned maximum is not completed buying.
COMPANY
Fortior plans a $118m acquisition of Sciosense
The proposed purchase of 100% of Sciosense plus shareholder loans remains subject to approvals. A shares closed at CNY199.31, down 2.46%, on Sep 30; a reliable Oct 5 Hong Kong close was unavailable, so market confirmation is not claimed.

US Overnight Trading Summary

FUTURES
Nasdaq-100 futures about +0.2%; S&P 500 futures edge higher
The 08:13 CST runtime evidence confirms continuation of overnight megacap-tech strength. A reliable Dow percentage was unavailable and is not invented.
CROSS-CHECK
Stale ranking snapshot prevents row-level representative-stock checks
The file covers only the Oct 2 cash session, not the latest Oct 5 session, so both groups have zero current rows. Old ELMT, TGB or PL samples cannot establish confirmation, divergence or reversal.
COMMODITIES
Lower oil plus firmer tech futures provides a modest buffer
WTI settled 1.84% lower, easing downstream costs at the margin; Brent above $100 and high bond yields still prevent a broad risk-on conclusion.

Pre-open Conclusion

Mainland shares remain closed; Hong Kong tech has passed the opening test.HSI and HSTECH opened over 1% higher, with HSTECH extending to about +1.35% by 09:31 and data-center/platform shares providing breadth confirmation. A 5.31% Treasury yield and Brent above $100 still cap chasing and valuation expansion. The four A-share company events still lack post-disclosure trades, while stale U.S. rankings remain excluded.

Stocks to Watch

ACM Research Shanghai
A.688082
CONDITIONAL WATCH
Catalyst: orders of CNY17.073bn, up 88.20%, provide direct semiconductor-equipment demand evidence.
Price evidence: Sep 30 close CNY294.28, -3.02%; the announcement was after the close and no post-event A-share quote exists during the holiday.
Confirm/invalidate: confirm on Oct 8 with stronger volume and relative strength; invalidate on a gap-and-fade below the pre-disclosure close or material order cancellations/delays.
China Merchants Energy Shipping
A.601872
CONDITIONAL WATCH
Catalyst: a 25-year contract for six VLOC vessels worth at least $2.8bn improves long-duration visibility.
Price evidence: Sep 30 close CNY20.15, +1.31%, but the formal disclosure came after the close.
Confirm/invalidate: confirm with post-holiday relative strength and delivery economics; capex overruns, delayed performance or weaker iron-ore transport demand invalidate.
HEC
A.600673
CONDITIONAL WATCH
Catalyst: a combined CNY0.6-1.2bn purchase plan plus a buyback proposal.
Price evidence: Sep 30 close CNY30.37; there is no post-announcement A-share trade, and the plan is not completed buying.
Confirm/invalidate: require actual purchase progress and post-reopen relative strength; slow execution or material underperformance invalidates.
Fortior Technology
A.688279 / H.01304
CONDITIONAL WATCH
Catalyst: the proposed $118m Sciosense acquisition could add sensing capabilities to motor-control chips.
Price evidence: A shares closed at CNY199.31, -2.46%, on Sep 30; H shares closed at HKD121.20 on Oct 5 and had zero shares traded at 09:31 on Oct 6, so the static prior close is not presented as positive acquisition feedback.
Confirm/invalidate: approvals, final terms and non-negative A/H price feedback confirm; valuation, approval, integration or goodwill problems invalidate.

Sector Rotation Board

Semiconductor equipmentPolicy plus ACM's order book are a dual catalyst; wait for Oct 8 volume, price and delivery confirmation.
Shipping / dry bulkThe long contract lifts visibility and lower oil helps costs; delivery, freight rates and iron-ore demand remain key.
Hong Kong technologyHSTECH opened +1.02% and reached about +1.35% by 09:31, with data-center and large platform shares broadly higher; local breadth confirms improvement, but high yields still leave fade risk.
Long-duration growthA 10-year Treasury yield near 5.31% leaves the rebound vulnerable and concentrated in leaders.

Logic Chain

Record Nasdaq and megacap leadership → positive Hong Kong tech mapping → HSI and HSTECH open over 1% higher with broad data-center gains, confirming the mapping locally.
Ranking snapshot misses Oct 5 → no valid sector/theme cross-section → old Top 5 rows cannot generate today's A/H themes or stocks.
ACM orders plus IC policy → semiconductor-equipment fundamental signal → price and order delivery require verification when A shares reopen Oct 8.
CMES 25-year contract plus lower oil → better visibility and cost expectations → vessel delivery, freight rates and contract execution determine realization.

Risk Radar

Rates and valuationThe 10-year yield near 5.31% leaves high-duration growth vulnerable to an intraday fade.
Holiday price vacuumMainland corporate announcements lack post-event trades; Oct 8 can bring gaps and profit-taking.
Data freshnessAKShare's A-share baseline is Sep 30 and U.S. rankings cover Oct 2 only; neither is presented as current.
M&A and contract executionAcquisitions need approvals and integration; long-term contracts require capex and years of performance.

Sources and Timestamps

The incremental window began at 2026-10-06 08:34 CST and was checked through 09:32 CST; one incremental item was found and one entered the brief. Domestic discovery reconciled Jin10 and CLS/STAR Market Daily with Securities Times/Eastmoney as a cross-source. entries.title: 美股盘前：油价与长债回落推升期指，CEG、AMD与NVDA获正反馈；IDCC重挫
entries.title_en: US premarket: Lower oil and yields lift futures; CEG, AMD and NVDA get positive feedback as IDCC tumbles
entries.summary: 截至20:36 CST，道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别上涨约0.55%、0.39%和0.61%，10年期美债收益率回落至约5.26%，Brent跌近2%至98.35美元。CEG因Google 3590兆瓦电力协议涨6.4%，AMD因2027年AI芯片增供计划涨1.9%，NVDA涨0.9%；OPCH的21%涨幅仅列并购套利观察，IDCC跌12.8%、AGCO跌7.0%。PENG今晚盘后财报给出中等beat概率判断。

关键词云图

期指齐涨油价跌破百CEG+6.4%AMD+1.9%NVDA+0.9%10债5.26%暂停78%OPCH并购纳指新高联储讲话IDCC-12.8%PENG财报
利好利空中性w1-w5表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
市场
三大期指同步上涨
Reuters截至美东07:29显示道指、标普500和纳指100期货分别上涨0.55%、0.39%和0.61%，风险偏好在开盘前改善。
利率
长债收益率从高位回落
10年期美债收益率回落至约5.26%，30年期约5.62%；估值压力边际缓和，但收益率仍处多年高位。
能源
Brent重新跌破100美元
Brent跌近2%至98.35美元，WTI约87.60美元；中东出口恢复与G7紧急库存释放缓解供应忧虑。
政策
10月暂停概率约78%
偏弱就业数据推后本月加息预期；市场计入10月按兵不动约78%，但12月加息仍被广泛定价。
科技
AI交易继续支撑大盘
纳指周一创收盘新高，NVDA与MSFT继续推动AI主线；标普500距离8月高点约0.6%。
芯片
AMD扩产获正反馈
AMD CEO称公司计划在2027年显著增加芯片供应以满足AI需求，AMD盘前上涨1.9%。
核电
Google签3590兆瓦电力协议
Google与Constellation Energy达成3590兆瓦电力协议，CEG盘前上涨6.4%，价格反馈明确为正。
龙头
NVDA与大型科技股走强
NVDA盘前涨0.9%；META、TSLA和AMZN均上涨超过0.5%，大型科技对指数形成支撑。
并购
OPCH暴涨仅作套利观察
Option Care Health因近50亿美元潜在收购交易报道盘前涨21%；涨幅主要来自交易溢价，不作为基本面趋势多头。
分化
IDCC与AGCO显著走弱
Barron's盘前数据显示InterDigital跌12.8%、AGCO跌7.0%，强指数下仍存在明显个股负反馈。

盘前结论

事实：三大期指上涨0.4%至0.6%，油价下跌、长债收益率回落；AMD、CEG与NVDA获得正价格反馈。

判断：开盘基线偏多，AI算力与电力基础设施有望领跑；但更适合追踪已获价格确认的强势股，而非无差别追高。

不确定性：长债绝对水平仍高，四位联储官员讲话及明日FOMC会议纪要可能让利率交易迅速反转。

重点个股推荐

Constellation EnergyCEG
电力协议

推荐理由：盘前涨6.4%，Google 3590兆瓦电力协议得到明确正价格反馈。

触发因素：开盘维持相对大盘强势，且协议规模与执行条款获得后续确认。

风险点：本轮可用源未返回带时标盘前成交量，不称放量；长期合同执行、资本开支与监管仍有不确定性。

Advanced Micro DevicesAMD
AI扩产

推荐理由：盘前涨1.9%，2027年显著增供计划回应AI需求并跑赢期指。

触发因素：开盘继续跑赢半导体指数，且扩产节奏不引发毛利率担忧。

风险点：本轮未获得可靠盘前成交量；高估值、供应执行与竞争压力仍可能放大波动。

NVIDIANVDA
AI龙头

推荐理由：盘前涨0.9%，在纳指创纪录后仍保持正反馈和龙头韧性。

触发因素：开盘守住盘前涨幅并继续跑赢纳指100与主要芯片同业。

风险点：本轮未获得可靠盘前成交量；若长债重新上冲，估值敏感度可能快速压制股价。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

AI芯片与电力基础设施；AMD、NVDA和CEG均获正价格反馈。

事件驱动

AMD扩产、Google—CEG电力协议，以及PENG今晚财报。

压力方向

IDCC、AGCO及高估值科技中的弱势个股；OPCH只作并购套利观察。

验证信号

10年期能否维持5.30%下方、纳指期货能否保持领先、CEG与AMD开盘后是否守住相对强势。

逻辑链

新闻事实

就业数据偏弱、油价下跌且长债回落，同时AI需求叙事延续。

资产反馈

三大期指齐涨，AMD/CEG/NVDA走强，而IDCC与AGCO下跌。

板块传导

资金偏向AI算力、电力与大型科技，弱势个股和并购标的继续分化。

开盘判断

若收益率维持回落，强势科技与电力有望延续；若联储讲话偏鹰，优先降低高估值敞口。

盘后财报 beat 概率

Penguin Solutions（PENG）—中概率：已核验Kiplinger、Nasdaq、TipRanks及TradingView日历，PENG确认于今晚盘后披露，当前一致EPS预期约0.77美元、收入预期约5.14亿至5.25亿美元。最近三季EPS均超过预期，上一季0.84美元高于约0.54美元，近四季平均EPS surprise约+27.8%；4月公司曾上调全年销售增速与EPS指引，AI基础设施和内存需求仍是景气依据。但本轮未检得可核实的临近财报卖方一致上修，且去年同期虽盈利超预期、收入与新年度指引偏弱后股价大跌，因此只给中概率而非高概率；这是判断，不是确定事实。

风险雷达

长债再上冲

10年期仍约5.26%；若重返5.35%以上，高估值AI股可能迅速回吐。

联储口径反转

至少四位官员今日讲话，任何偏鹰信号都可能压低10月暂停概率。

地缘与能源反复

Brent虽跌破100美元，但中东供应仍有扰动风险，油价反弹会重燃通胀交易。

个股负反馈

IDCC跌12.8%、AGCO跌7.0%，说明强指数不能覆盖公司特定风险。

财报预期落差

PENG历史beat不保证本季；收入、指引与AI订单兑现比单一EPS更重要。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时点：Reuters截至美东07:29的期指、个股、利率、油价与Fed定价；AP约美东早盘的WTI与10年期收益率；Barron's约开盘前两小时的CEG、TAP、IDCC与AGCO价格反馈；Kiplinger、Nasdaq、TipRanks、TradingView及公开历史数据核验PENG财报。内容于2026-10-06 20:36 CST（08:36 ET）复核；个股盘前成交量未获带时标可靠回读，因此均未表述为放量。

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage change.
Major News
Market
All three futures gauges rise
Reuters showed Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.55%, 0.39% and 0.61% at 7:29 a.m. ET, signaling firmer pre-open risk appetite.
Rates
Long yields ease from highs
The 10-year Treasury yield eased to about 5.26% and the 30-year to about 5.62%; valuation pressure softened at the margin, but yields remain near multiyear highs.
Energy
Brent falls back below $100
Brent fell nearly 2% to $98.35 and WTI traded near $87.60 as recovering Middle East exports and a G7 emergency stock release eased supply fears.
Policy
October hold odds near 78%
Softer jobs data pushed back near-term hike expectations; markets price roughly a 78% chance of no October move, while a December hike remains largely priced.
Technology
AI trade keeps supporting equities
The Nasdaq closed at a record Monday as NVDA and MSFT sustained the AI theme; the S&P 500 finished about 0.6% below its August high.
Chips
AMD supply plan gets positive feedback
AMD's CEO said the company plans to substantially increase chip supply in 2027 to meet AI demand; AMD rose 1.9% premarket.
Power
Google signs 3,590-MW agreement
Google entered a 3,590-MW power agreement with Constellation Energy; CEG gained 6.4% premarket, a clear positive price response.
Leaders
NVDA and megacaps advance
NVDA rose 0.9% premarket, while META, TSLA and AMZN each gained more than 0.5%, supporting the indexes.
M&A
OPCH surge is arbitrage only
Option Care Health jumped 21% on reports of a potential nearly $5 billion acquisition; the move is mainly deal premium, not a fundamental trend-long signal.
Divergence
IDCC and AGCO weaken sharply
Barron's premarket data showed InterDigital down 12.8% and AGCO down 7.0%, evidence of sharp single-stock negative feedback despite firm indexes.

Premarket Conclusion

Fact: All three futures gauges are up 0.4%-0.6% as oil and long yields fall; AMD, CEG and NVDA have positive price confirmation.

View: The opening baseline is constructive, with AI compute and power infrastructure likely to lead; focus on price-confirmed strength instead of indiscriminate chasing.

Uncertainty: Long yields remain high, and four Fed speakers plus Wednesday's FOMC minutes could quickly reverse the rates trade.

Focus Stocks

Constellation EnergyCEG
Power deal

Why it stands out: Shares rose 6.4% premarket, clearly validating Google's 3,590-MW power agreement.

Trigger: Maintain relative strength after the open and receive follow-through confirmation on scale and execution terms.

Risk: No reliable time-stamped premarket volume was available, so this is not described as high-volume; execution, capex and regulatory risks remain.

Advanced Micro DevicesAMD
AI supply

Why it stands out: Shares gained 1.9% premarket as the 2027 supply expansion plan addressed AI demand and outperformed futures.

Trigger: Continue outperforming the semiconductor index without the expansion plan raising margin concerns.

Risk: Reliable premarket volume was unavailable; valuation, supply execution and competition can amplify volatility.

NVIDIANVDA
AI leader

Why it stands out: Shares rose 0.9% premarket and retained leadership after the Nasdaq's record close.

Trigger: Hold the premarket gain after the open and keep outperforming the Nasdaq 100 and major chip peers.

Risk: Reliable premarket volume was unavailable; a rebound in long yields could pressure valuation quickly.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watch

AI chips and power infrastructure; AMD, NVDA and CEG all have positive price confirmation.

Event driven

AMD's supply plan, the Google-CEG power agreement and PENG earnings tonight.

Pressure areas

IDCC, AGCO and weak high-valuation technology names; OPCH is only a merger-arbitrage watch.

Validation signals

Whether the 10-year stays below 5.30%, Nasdaq futures retain leadership, and CEG/AMD hold relative strength after the open.

Logic Chain

News facts

Softer jobs data, lower oil and easing long yields combine with continuing AI-demand optimism.

Asset response

All three futures gauges rise; AMD/CEG/NVDA advance while IDCC and AGCO fall.

Sector transmission

Capital favors AI compute, power and megacaps, while weak single names and merger targets diverge.

Opening view

If yields stay lower, strong technology and power can extend; if Fed speakers turn hawkish, reduce high-duration exposure.

After-hours Earnings Beat Probability

Penguin Solutions (PENG) — Medium probability: Kiplinger, Nasdaq, TipRanks and TradingView calendars were checked; PENG is confirmed to report after the close, with consensus EPS around $0.77 and revenue near $514M-$525M. EPS beat estimates in each of the last three quarters; last quarter's $0.84 topped roughly $0.54 and the four-quarter average EPS surprise was about +27.8%. The company raised full-year sales-growth and EPS guidance in April, while AI infrastructure and memory demand remain supportive. However, this run found no verifiable last-minute consensus upward revision, and a year ago the shares fell after an EPS beat because revenue and new-year guidance disappointed. The call is therefore Medium, not High; it is a judgment, not a fact.

Risk Radar

Long yields rebound

The 10-year is still near 5.26%; a move back above 5.35% could quickly hit high-valuation AI names.

Fed tone reverses

At least four officials speak today, and hawkish signals could reduce October hold odds.

Geopolitics and energy

Brent is below $100, but Middle East supply risk remains; another oil spike would revive the inflation trade.

Single-stock negatives

IDCC fell 12.8% and AGCO 7.0%, showing that firm indexes do not eliminate company-specific risk.

Earnings expectation gap

PENG's historical beats do not guarantee this quarter; revenue, guidance and AI-order conversion matter more than EPS alone.

Data Sources and Timing

Sources and timing: Reuters through 7:29 a.m. ET for futures, stocks, rates, oil and Fed pricing; AP for early-ET WTI and the 10-year yield; Barron's about two hours before the open for CEG, TAP, IDCC and AGCO price feedback; Kiplinger, Nasdaq, TipRanks, TradingView and public history for PENG earnings. Rechecked at 8:36 a.m. ET (2026-10-06 20:36 CST). Reliable time-stamped premarket volume was unavailable for the stock picks, so none is described as high-volume.
